tool_args.rationale: The pilot and open-branch observations show substrate–gradient interaction, but sparse, correlated inputs leave the shape of that interaction underidentified. A fine trajectory batch can distinguish competing smooth mechanisms before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the recalled siphon law immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Six observations with coupled variation in substrate and gradient do not reliably distinguish its parameters or functional form from other smooth interacting mechanisms.
Already acquired; its single additional row leaves substantial model ambiguity.
The nuisance measurement does not resolve the relevant mechanism.
